item.title: Power mostly restored after massive San Francisco outage leaves 130,000 PG&E customers without electricity
item.description: By Jose Fabian About 5,000 San Francisco Pacific Gas and Electric customers were still without power Monday after a massive power outage left about a third of the city in the dark on Saturday, the utility company said. PG&E said the remaining customers without power were mostly in the Richmond, Presidio and Civic Center neighborhoods.
